At Itility, we work with a team of 300+ engineers, data scientists, project managers, and architects on digital solutions that truly matter. We support clients in the manufacturing, energy, and earth observation sectors with their digital transformation. We do not do this by implementing standard solutions, but by deploying technology smartly and purposefully to improve processes, accelerate innovation, and increase societal impact.
 Recently, in order to facilitate our increasing number of customers, we have decided to expand our operation and open a tech office in Iasi, Romania. So if you are a technology enthusiast with a desire to work in a team of highly skilled professionals, while delivering value to our customers, Itility might just be the place for you.
 Your role
 We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer for a high-tech semiconductor customer in The Netherlands.
 Do you want to make an impact at leading enterprise clients in the field of DevOps or SRE?
 Are you a DevOps Engineer with a passion for automation and the cloud? Do you have experience setting up and managing automated IT environments? Then this is your chance to work on challenging projects at Itility!
We help our clients simplify and smarten their IT landscape. No more manual work, but automation using software-driven solutions. This way, we remove complexity and ensure fully automated management environments.
 What You Are Going To Do
 Create and maintain Windows virtual machines using Azure DevOps pipelines.
 Build and maintain Windows Jenkins agents for CI/CD execution.
 Create and maintain Jenkins pipelines to:
Run and validate C# Avalonia GUI application tests natively on Windows.
Build Docker images embedding the C++ gRPC backend server.
Deploy Docker images to Windows VMs and execute automated test workflows.
 Design and operate CI/CD workflows using ephemeral Docker-based build environments in Azure.
 Create and maintain Apptainer (Singularity) containers to support portable and reproducible application execution.
 Maintain and extend CMake build systems
 Build and maintain Docker images
 Maintain and evolve Jenkins infrastructure and pipelines.
 Ensure reliable integration between C++ backend services and C# GUI via gRPC communication.
 Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues across Windows and Linux environments.
 Collaborate with developers to improve build stability, reproducibility, and CI/CD performance.
 This is what we offer
You will have the opportunity to develop yourself to your full potential, under the personal guidance of the rest of the team. In addition to a competitive salary, you will receive extras such as:
26 vacation days
Meal vouchers
Performance bonus opportunity appliable twice a year
Private health insurance
Private pension option
Itility Academy - hard & soft skills training
Hybrid working
 This is you
Naturally, you are committed, driven, and enjoy working in a world that is constantly changing. To do that successfully, you need:
Strong experience with DevOps principles and CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance.
Hands-on experience with Jenkins (pipelines, agents, and administration).
Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and infrastructure automation.
Strong knowledge of Docker and containerized build/release workflows.
Experience with Windows and Linux system administration in CI/CD contexts.
Experience building and maintaining Windows-based CI agents and automation workflows.
Strong CMake knowledge for multi-platform C++ build systems.
Experience supporting C++ build, packaging, and deployment across multiple Linux distributions (RHEL, Ubuntu, OpenEuler, Wind River Linux).
Experience with cross-platform build troubleshooting and dependency management.
Familiarity with gRPC or similar service communication frameworks.
Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
Ability to work in complex heterogeneous environments (Windows + Linux + containerized systems).
